I would like to understand the recent development of 2D and 3D spatial understanding/reasoning of vision-language models (general-purpose or task-specific ones). Please help me draft a literature review section in the style of NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR papers. The section should contain multiple paragraphs, where each paragraph illustrates the progression of a coherent line of research .
Requirements: (1) Only include papers published in top AI conferences and journals (ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, EMNLP, ACL, AAAI, TPAMI, COLING, TMLR, IJCV, etc.). Do not include preprints from arXiv. (2) Focus specifically on the development of the field from 2022–2025. (3)  Spatial understanding includes tasks such as object counting, navigation, grounding/localization, and general visual reasoning. (4) You should cover model architectures, evaluation & benchmarks/datasets, and methodologies.
